workloads.name: arithmetic_loop
workloads.description: 9,000,000 iterations of integer multiply/add/divide in a hot loop.

workloads.name: function_call_loop
workloads.description: 9,000,000 source-level calls to add(sum, delta) in a bounded state-dependent recurrence; optimizing runtimes may inline.

workloads.name: actor_mailbox
workloads.description: One state-owning actor/task receives 250,000 ordered increment messages followed by a report message.

workloads.name: actor_self_chain
workloads.description: One actor/task performs 250,000 turns by sending the next tick to its own mailbox, then reports the completed turn count.

workloads.name: actor_fanout_fanin
workloads.description: 64 independent workers each process 2,000 ordered work messages, then fan in their counters to one collector.

workloads.name: actor_runtime_baseline
workloads.description: Start the language runtime in actor-capable mode, create no actors/tasks/processes, print 0, and exit.

workloads.name: actor_spawn_100k
workloads.description: Create 100,000 lightweight actors/processes/goroutines that remain resident until process exit.
